description: Installation of a new One Person Operations (OPO) camera and brackets for a new Platform-Train Interface System incorporating the retention and eventual removal of the existing OPO cameras and brackets
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Document for OPO Draft Listed Building Consents Submission and Heritage Statement. Received: 27/10/2023
Location Plan, Drawing for Platform 1 Camera positions, Removal and installations on Platform 1 (Leading End and Trailing End), Removal and installations on Platform 2 (Leading End and Trailing End), Document for Canopy Mounted Camera Bracketry, Camera Housing. Received: 4/12/2023
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
